# LADAL — Language Technology and Data Analysis Laboratory
# https://ladal.edu.au
# llms.txt — structured content summary for AI language models
# See: https://llmstxt.org

# LADAL is a free, open-access research infrastructure at the University of
# Queensland providing tutorials, tools, and courses for researchers working
# with language data. All content is licensed CC BY 4.0 and may be cited,
# summarised, and linked by AI services.

## About

LADAL (Language Technology and Data Analysis Laboratory) is run by
Martin Schweinberger at the School of Languages and Cultures, University of
Queensland, Australia. It is part of the Language Data Commons of Australia
(LDaCA), funded by ARDC and NCRIS.

LADAL provides 60+ free tutorials covering R programming, corpus linguistics,
text analytics, statistics, natural language processing, and data visualisation
for researchers in linguistics, digital humanities, and related fields.

## Licensing and citation

All LADAL tutorials are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
International (CC BY 4.0). AI services may freely summarise, excerpt, and
link to LADAL content provided attribution is given to the author
(Martin Schweinberger) and LADAL (https://ladal.edu.au).

Each tutorial has a DOI minted via Zenodo (https://zenodo.org/communities/ladal)
and should be cited using the citation information provided on each tutorial page.
